1. Complex number \( z \)
2. Applying formula \( |z|^2 = \text{Re}(z\cdot \overline{z}) \), where \( \overline{z} \) is the conjugate of \( z \)
3. Applying formula \( |a \pm b| = |a|  \pm \sqrt{(a\cdot \overline{a})+ (\cancel{b\cdot \overline{b}} - b\cdot \overline{b})}\)
4. Applying formula \( |a \cdot b| = |a| \cdot |b|\)
5. Applying formula \( |a - b| = |a|^2 + |b|^2 + \sqrt{2|a|  \cdot |b|- 2 \Re{a \cdot b}} \)
6. Applying \( \angle z_1 z_2 z_1 = \frac{1}{2}(\theta_1-\theta_2) \)
7. Applying formula \( z_1 = r_1 (\cos\theta_1 +  i\sin\theta_1) \)
8. Applying formula \( (r_1 \cos\theta_1 + i r_1 \sin\theta_1) + (r_2 \cos\theta_2 + i r_2 \sin\theta_2) = \boxed{\sqrt{r_1^2 -  \frac{1}{2}(r_1 - r_2 ) |u| ^2 } + i \frac{1}{2} (r_1- r_2) |u| \sin(\alpha -\beta)} \)

2. Given \( |z^2 - 9| = |z(z - 3i)| \)
3. Expanding both sides using \( z = x + yi \)
4. Simplifying the left side by the provided formula
5. Simplifying the right side using \( |ab| = |a||b| \)
6. Equating the simplified expressions
7. Deriving a quadratic in terms of \( x \) and \( y \)
8. Solving the resulting quadratic equation
9. Finding the roots
10. Applying the distance formula to find \( |z - 2i| \)
11. Determining the smallest possible value of \( |z - 2i| \)
